Index.meta_description: Next js Boilerplate is the perfect starter code for your project. Build your React application with the Next.js framework.
Index.features_heading: Boilerplate code for your Next.js project with Tailwind CSS
Index.features_description: A developer-friendly starter built with Tailwind CSS and TypeScript. <zap></zap> Designed with developer experience in mind, it includes:
Index.feature_db: Dev database with PGlite, production with <neon>Neon</neon>
Index.feature_forms: Form handling (React Hook Form) and validation (Zod)
Index.feature_git: Git hooks and commit linting (Lefthook, Commitlint)
Index.feature_testing: Testing suite (Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright)
Index.feature_seo: SEO optimization (metadata, JSON-LD, Open Graph tags)
Index.feature_devtools: Development tools (VSCode config, bundler analyzer, changelog)
